performance_history.note: Graded the most recent published issue (#7, sent 2026-08-17). 13 emails sent, 13 delivered (100% delivery), 30.77% open rate (4 unique opens), 25% verified click rate (1 unique verified click, 50% raw), 7.69% unsubscribe rate (1 unsubscribe), 0 spam reports, 0 web views. No issue has been sent since 2026-08-17, an ~11 week gap; active subscribers slipped from 14 to 12 and last-7-days growth and engagement are flat at 0 because nothing has shipped recently. Takeaway: cadence is the main lever. On a 12 to 13 person list, open rate is reasonable but absolute engagement is tiny, and a single unsubscribe reads as a high percentage. Regular sends should be re-established.

ad_network_notes: Issue #8: the publication allows only ONE 'primary' (with-logo) ad slot per post; placing 3 primary ads was rejected. The account also could not accept any NEW ad opportunities (it had several already-accepted but unplaced opportunities from prior runs sitting against its acceptance cap). Fix that worked: embed already-accepted opportunities (list_ad_opportunities, status=accepted) by their UUIDs instead of claiming fresh numeric offer IDs, using 1 primary + 2 secondary. Lesson for future runs: prefer embedding existing accepted opportunities when the account is near its acceptance cap, and keep at most one primary per post.
